title: The model-diff workflow runs no PR-controlled Maven code while the Packages credential is on disk, and does not persist the checkout token

criteria.given: model-diff.yml checks out the pull request
criteria.then: the checkout does not persist the job's GitHub token (persist-credentials: false)

criteria.given: the step that writes ~/.m2/settings.xml with GH_PACKAGES_TOKEN
criteria.then: it is preceded by a step that checks out the trusted base commit, so every Maven run that sees the credential builds base code

criteria.given: the steps after the credential is written
criteria.then: the settings file is removed before the PR commit is checked out again, and no mvn command runs after that removal
